summary_points: The document is an instrument specification for the Solana project.
It includes definitions for Supplier, Customer, Fabricator, Owner, and Contract Documents.
The scope of work involves supplying instruments and related items.
Supplier must provide a single contact person for tracking material purchases.
Confidentiality notice regarding the use and reproduction of information.
RFQ No., Job, Spec No., Item No., Project, Ref. Issue date provided.
Quality requirements for all materials to meet NEC, IEEE, UL standards.
Vendor data commitment crucial for project progress.
Quotation must include time for approval drawings and fabrication.
Equipment delivery to purchaser's manufacturing site with specific locations.
Strict shipment schedule by July 2012.
Spare parts list required for one year's maintenance with prices and delivery details.
Inspection by Abener Teyma personnel before shipment.
Right to perform inspection activities during fabrication and prior to shipment.
Recommendations invited for improving price, delivery or performance.
The document contains specifications for differential pressure level transmitters.
Two models are specified: S26MA.H.C1.S.SM.A.E.S.1.2 + SR11090 and S26MA.L.C1.S.SM.A.E.S.1.2 + SR11090.
The instruments operate at 3045 psig pressure with a design temperature of up to 750 ºF.
Output range is 4-20mA with HART protocol, and power supply is 24VDC.
Chemical seal type is Dual - 1" Chem Seal, Capillary, OFF-Lined.
The instruments are mounted remotely using a 2" pipe mounting kit.
Calibration certificates must be provided by the vendor.
